VISA/INSTITUTIONAL LETTERHEAD

Please note that most people need a visa or an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) to travel to Canada – not both. Some people may only need their valid passport. To find out specific entry requirements for your country, please visit this website: https://ircc.canada.ca/english/visit/visas.asp.
